description: The AD_UNITS config (JS literal, URL-overridable) could not be evaluated, so no ad units were built.
Appending the ad stack scripts to the page threw or rejected.
An Amazon APS bid arrived without a usable size, so it could not be rendered.
apstag.fetchBids never called back (apstag.js blocked or stubbed).
apstag.init threw.
Rendering an APS creative inside a SafeFrame threw.
Building the APS slot list threw after requestBids, so APS never bid.
A refresh or lazy auction never finished because a bidder callback never fired; the slot stays empty.
The WebView mute shim (evaluateJavaScript) failed, so ad audio may not be muted.
The banner has neither a GAM tag nor a zone id, so it renders a blank slot.
A script inside the banner HTML (gpt.js or the zone script) failed to load.
Reading the winning bid (isVideo) threw, so video mute enforcement was skipped.
The Prebid auctionEnd event had no noBids/bidsReceived arrays, so the bid monitor threw.
A configured bidder has an empty required param, so its bid is dropped.
Removing a bidder from the ad units failed (Prebid APIs missing).
The Boltive script failed to load (blocked), so its protection is off.
The Funding Choices CMP script failed to load; ads fail open.
The CMP loaded but never signaled ready, so ads never initialize.
The CONSENT_MANAGEMENT config could not be decoded or evaluated.
The GPP listener reported a failure.
googlefc.getConsentStatus() threw inside the consent callback.
The TCF callback returned no success or no data, so ads are not initialized.
Rendering a direct (non-GAM) ad threw; a house ad is used instead.
GAM failed to load an ad for a reason other than no-fill (network, invalid request, internal). No-fill stays on adError.
No GAM ad unit is configured (gamTag and GAM both empty), so Google's test ad unit is used.
Google Mobile Ads initialization threw.
Serializing imp.ext (gpid plus bidder params) failed, so no gpid is sent.
Reading a GPT slot (getSlotElementId) threw.
googletag.defineSlot failed or returned null (bad GAM path), so nothing renders.
Appending an ad script to the document head threw.
The hashed-email identity was dropped because Prebid was not ready to take it.
Merging Identity Hub user ids into the Prebid config threw.
The ad iframe had no contentWindow, so nothing was written into it.
The Lotame bootstrap threw.
The Lotame sync script failed to load.
A Lotame sync was requested before the Lotame client loaded.
The MediaFuse script failed to load; GPT starts without it.
A native bid won but the cache id was missing or the native ad could not be created. No-fill stays on adError.
A native ad image was rejected or failed to download.
Removing the opsco bidder after the first auction threw.
Serializing the global ORTB config failed, so app.publisher, device.geo and devicetype are missing.
A video creative won a banner-only zone (the existing placementMismatch event is also sent).
The Prebid auction returned an error result code other than no-bids (for example an invalid config id).
Prebid Mobile initialization threw or completed with an error, so every auction waits and may run without Prebid.
Prebid Mobile initialization finished with a non-success status.
Prebid was not ready after the cold-start wait, so the ad loaded without header bidding.
The Prebid rendering banner failed to load an ad for a reason other than no-fill.
prebid.js or gpt.js failed to load, so the ad stack cannot run.
No view controller was available to present the Prebid rendering banner.
Updating the ortb2Imp refresh count threw.
The S2S_CONFIG value could not be decoded or evaluated.
The SafeFrame renderer had no ad markup (adUrl or cached bid), so the frame is blank.
A SafeFrame message was not valid JSON.
A SafeFrame message carried an unknown command.
A SafeFrame reply was dropped because the iframe had no contentWindow.
The ad view was loaded or resumed before setup().
The requested ad size is missing or not numeric, which gives a 0x0 or NaN slot.
The ad slot element was not in the page when its scripts ran.
Injecting the inline slot script threw.
A slot size could not be parsed from its id or size string, so a default size was used.
The ad view was created from a storyboard (init(coder:)), which is not supported.
The in-view observer failed to observe or disconnect.
An ad placement needs a zone id and none was given, so the auction is skipped.
Serializing the remote config across the React Native bridge failed, so bidder passthrough is lost.
A config value from JS has the wrong type or is incomplete for the native bridge.
setExternalUserIds got an entry without source, uids or id; it was skipped.
Emitting an event to JS failed because the React instance is gone.
setGeo got a payload that is not an object, so geo was cleared.
A WebView bridge message had a missing or wrong-typed field (type, url, listing, zoneId, message).
A WebView bridge message was not valid JSON.
A WebView bridge message had an unknown type.
The SellwildRNModule native module is not registered, so native commands are no-ops.
A native view manager (banner or feed) is not registered, so the React Native view renders nothing.
A native view got missing props or an unsupported size label, so no ad was set up.
The widget page reported a JavaScript error through the bridge ERROR message.
Replacement action when a call site passes a code that fails the registry format. The label keeps the caller component. Never pass it directly.
The A/B split value is not a number, so variant B always wins.
No A/B variant is configured, so an empty bundle name is loaded.
AD_STACK or an AD_STACK_BY_ZONE entry is not a known mode (or not a map); the default is used.
APP_STORE_URL has no /id<number> segment, so app.bundle keeps the reverse-DNS default.
Applying the fetched config threw; defaults are kept.
An element attribute value could not be decoded or parsed (malformed %-encoding or JSON).
A BANNER_SIZES entry could not be parsed or has non-positive dimensions; it was dropped.
A configured color string is not a valid color; the fallback color is used.
The remote config request returned a non-2xx status (a missing file returns 403 AccessDenied XML).
The remote config request failed at the network level (DNS, offline, TLS, reset).
The remote config body is not valid JSON.
The remote config request did not answer within the client timeout.
A config field has an unexpected type or value and was ignored or coerced.
A config field that holds JSON text could not be parsed; the default is used.
LOCATION_MAP is not valid JSON, is badly %-encoded, or does not contain the slug.
The host app's overrides callback threw during configure.
The remote config JSON is valid but not an object (array, string or null).
AD_REFRESH_INTERVAL looks like seconds rather than milliseconds.
The stored remote config JSON could not be parsed, so every remote flag falls back to its default.
A required theme value (colors) is empty, so 'undefined' reaches the CSS.
Decoding a theme or build-time config string threw (malformed %-sequence).
The remote config URL could not be built from partnerCode and slug.
Decoding a page URL parameter threw (malformed %-sequence).
The COL1 layout asks for an ad or banner row but no zone is configured, so the row is dropped.
A dequeued feed cell had an unexpected type.
A listing photo URL was rejected (scheme), too large, or could not be decoded.
A listing photo failed to download.
The COL1 layout contains an unknown token; it was ignored.
Opening a listing or partner URL threw (no browser, no presenter).
A listing or partner URL was refused because it is not http(s).
The feed was loaded before setup().
The feed adapter got an unknown view type.
The listings response had no CloudFront viewer geo headers, so geo, GDPR and CCPA decisions run without location.
GrowthCode is enabled but the partner id or sync URL is missing, so the sync cannot run.
The GrowthCode eid blob is not an array, or entries lack source/uids/id; they were dropped.
The GrowthCode eid blob (eb) is not valid JSON.
The GrowthCode sync returned a non-2xx status; the throttle is not saved, so it retries next launch.
The GrowthCode sync response is valid JSON but not an object.
The GrowthCode sync request failed at the network level.
The GrowthCode sync response is not valid JSON.
GrowthCode sync POST timed out. The throttle is not persisted, so it retries next launch.
The GrowthCode endpoint URL could not be built.
Registering the GPT slotRenderEnded listener for house ads failed.
A house ad image was rejected (scheme), too large, or could not be decoded.
A house ad image failed to download.
House-ad slots waited for listings that never arrived.
Loading listings for house-ad backfill failed.
Opening a house ad click URL threw.
A house ad click URL was refused because it is not http(s).
The listings client was released or disposed while a request was in flight.
The listings GET returned a non-2xx status.
The listings request finished without a body.
The listings GET failed at the network level (DNS, offline, TLS, reset).
The listings body is not valid JSON (for example an HTML error page).
Listings GET did not answer within the client timeout.
A listing item or one of its fields (photo, price, currency) has an unexpected shape; it was dropped or hidden.
Decoding a listing item threw (strict casts on real payloads).
A listing URL could not be parsed when building the click URL.
The listings JSON is valid but has no result.rs array.
Loading the legacy partners list failed.
Encoding the JSON-RPC listings request failed.
The listings response had zero items, so listing slots stay empty.
The tag-cache listings response is not an array.
The tag-cache listings request failed.
The listings URL is not a valid URL.
LOCALIZED_LISTINGS is set but not an object, or lacks baseUrl/urlTemplate; the feature is off.
LOCALIZED_LISTINGS holds JSON text that could not be parsed; the feature is off.
The localized cache returned a non-2xx status other than the expected 403/404 for a state without a cache.
The localized cache request finished without a body.
The localized (per-state) cache request failed at the network level.
The localized cache body is not valid JSON.
Localized (per-state) listings cache GET timed out. The primary feed renders alone.
The localized cache JSON has no result.rs array.
The localized cache URL could not be built from baseUrl and urlTemplate.
Creating the on-disk cache directory failed.
Reading or parsing a stored value (localStorage, prefs) failed.
Writing a stored value (localStorage, disk cache) failed.
The video ad player (IMA) reported an ad error other than no-ad. The existing adError event is also sent.
The fullscreen video ad never reached a terminal callback, so content never resumed.
The video ad container element was missing when the ad started.
The current video has no sources, so the ad request used a fallback content URL.
The sellwild-video custom element is not registered in this bundle, so video ads cannot run.
The video ad-unit or bids JSON could not be parsed.
A public player method was called before the player was ready.
hls.js raised an unrecoverable fatal error; playback falls back to the native source.
hls.js is not loaded when HLS playback is needed.
hls.js raised a fatal network error.
Stopping or destroying hls.js threw during cleanup.
Creating or attaching hls.js threw; playback falls back to the native source.
hls.js raised a fatal media error.
Accessing the iHeart player frame threw (cross-origin or missing).
The iHeart player was not found when the widget looked for it.
The Google IMA SDK failed to load.
The current video index went out of range.
A playlist video lacks required fields (id, user, listings, tags).
The current video has no id, so the like toggle did nothing.
The video element raised a media error.
video.play() was rejected (for example autoplay NotAllowedError).
Starting the video player threw.
The playlist JSON is not an array.
No playable videos remained after filtering, so the player has nothing to show.
The playlist request failed at the network level.
The playlist response is non-2xx or not valid JSON.
The inline playlist (attribute or URL parameter) is not valid JSON.
Prebid never became available for the video ad request.
Seeking before the media metadata loaded threw.
Every video source failed and no alternative is left.
A video source failed to load; the next source is tried.
A video has an empty sources list.
The tag-cache query built from page keywords is malformed.
An admin API call returned a non-2xx status.
An admin API call returned an unexpected result.
The admin page is missing a required dependency (window.CMS).
An admin API call failed at the network level.
Serializing a remote config value into a widget attribute failed; the attribute was left out.
The browser has no customElements, so the widget cannot mount (the existing customElementsNotSupported event is also sent).
A DOM read or teardown call threw.
An element the widget template expects is missing.
Mounting, rendering or rebuilding a widget element threw (the existing errorAddingElement event is also sent where it exists).
customElements.define threw (the tag was already defined by another bundle).
requestFullscreen was rejected.
A host app callback (onLoad, onListingTap, onAdImpression, onError) threw inside the SDK.
A listing photo URL is missing, so the image source is undefined.
Listing images for the widget failed to load.
Widget bootstrap threw (missing MutationObserver, first render error).
IntersectionObserver is not available, so a feature that requires it threw.
The widget layout contains an unknown token; it renders nothing.
The listingAction RPC failed.
The widget never signaled that it loaded (bridge down, partner.js failed); the spinner never ends.
Reading page metadata threw; partial metadata is used.
A JSON-LD block on the host page is not valid JSON.
The page URL or a path segment could not be decoded for targeting.
A React render error was caught by the error boundary.
A script the widget needs (partner.js, hls.js, a variant bundle) failed to load.
The search submit handler threw.
A configured CSS selector is invalid, so querySelector threw.
A configured CSS selector matched nothing.
The session RPC response had no result.rs.userId.
The session RPC (createRemoteSession) failed.
The native widget view was loaded before setup().
navigator.share threw or was rejected.
The widget WebView failed to load its page or a main resource (offline, DNS, TLS, navigation failure).
The WebView content process crashed or was killed (iOS webViewWebContentProcessDidTerminate, Android onRenderProcessGone). The widget is blank until reloaded.
